description: The chart illustrates the average performance of various models across three categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis lists the model names, which are labeled and ordered alphabetically. Each category has a corresponding horizontal bar chart with a percentage scale ranging from 0% to 100% on the horizontal axis, with tick labels at 20% intervals. The Understanding category has values ranging from 2.4% to 98.0%, the Reasoning category from 7.2% to 66.5%, and the Trustworthiness category from 0.0% to 88.8%. Each model is represented by a set of three bars, one for each category, colored in different shades of blue, with the exact shade varying across models. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each category, and some models have significantly longer bars than others. For instance, 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20' has the longest bar in the Understanding category at 98.0%, while 'Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407' has the shortest at 2.4%. In the Reasoning category, 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20' again has the longest bar at 66.5%, and 'Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407' has the shortest at 7.2%. In the Trustworthiness category, 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18' has the longest bar at 88.8%, and 'Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407' has the shortest at 0.0%. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bars.
